title: Trinity Jack CQRS Gate
description: Route all Trinity graph mutations through one CQRS gate: TrinityGraphOp catalog, Jack execute emits ops, TrinityHost dispatch store, remove TS shims, wire undo/redo/checkpoint to WASM.
summary: Routed all Trinity graph mutations through one CQRS gate. Added manifest-validated TrinityGraphOp catalog with Operation/OperationDiff in trinity_ram (CreateNode, DeleteNode, CreateEdge, DeleteEdge, Rename, Reposition, SetDataProperty, ClearDataProperty). Jack execute() is read-only and emits Vec<TrinityGraphOp>; dead TrinityFixtureOp stub removed. TrinityHost owns TrinityGraphStore with dispatch() routing run_jack*, apply_rewrite_json, drag-commit Reposition ops, and reorganize(); WASM exports undo/redo/commitCheckpoint/storeGeneration. Removed duplicated TS DocumentVcsStore shims from jack/rewrite play; controllers use fixtureJson cache + TrinityCanvas jackDispatch/vcsRequest wired to WASM session. Toolbar undo/redo/checkpoint added. Rebuilt trinity_rewrite WASM. Tests: cargo trinity_ram (9), trinity_jack (17), trinity_rewrite (11 incl. jack create undo); vitest jack play (14), rewrite play (19).
